title: Sleep beside giraffes at a conservation sanctuary
description: Stay in a suite inside a giraffe barn with enormous windows facing the animals' indoor habitat. Private keeper encounters can include giraffe and rhino feeding, sloth time and enrichment activities.
teaser: Stay in a suite inside a giraffe barn with enormous windows facing the animals' indoor habitat.
goodToKnow: The earlier research listed a two-night minimum and a Giraffe Suite rate around $1,600 per night. The suite requires stairs; ask about villa access and which encounters are included.
